ade_instruction_guidance: 70% of instructional time on Major Clusters

clusters.description: Understand ratio concepts and use ratio reasoning to solve problems

standards.description: Understand the concept of a ratio and use ratio language to describe a ratio relationship between two quantities
Understand the concept of a unit rate a/b associated with a ratio a:b with b ≠ 0
Use ratio and rate reasoning to solve real-world and mathematical problems

sub.description: Make tables of equivalent ratios, find missing values, plot pairs on a coordinate plane
Solve unit rate problems including unit pricing and constant speed
Find a percent of a quantity; solve problems involving finding the whole given a part and percent
Use ratio reasoning to convert measurement units

clusters.description: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division to divide fractions by fractions

standards.description: Interpret and compute quotients of fractions; solve word problems involving division of fractions by fractions

clusters.description: Compute fluently with multi-digit numbers and find common factors and multiples

standards.description: Fluently divide multi-digit numbers using the standard algorithm
Fluently add, subtract, multiply, and divide multi-digit decimals using the standard algorithm
Find GCF of two whole numbers ≤ 100 and LCM of two whole numbers ≤ 12; use the distributive property to express a sum with a common factor

clusters.description: Apply and extend previous understandings of numbers to the system of rational numbers

standards.description: Understand that positive and negative numbers describe quantities having opposite directions or values
Understand a rational number as a point on the number line; extend to coordinate axes with negative coordinates
Understand ordering and absolute value of rational numbers
Solve real-world problems by graphing points in all four quadrants of the coordinate plane

clusters.description: Apply and extend previous understandings of arithmetic to algebraic expressions

standards.description: Write and evaluate numerical expressions involving whole-number exponents
Write, read, and evaluate expressions in which letters stand for numbers

sub.description: Write expressions that record operations with numbers and variables
Identify parts of an expression using mathematical terms (sum, term, product, factor, quotient, coefficient)
Evaluate expressions at specific values of their variables

standards.description: Apply the properties of operations to generate equivalent expressions
Identify when two expressions are equivalent

clusters.description: Reason about and solve one-variable equations and inequalities

standards.description: Understand solving an equation or inequality as a process of answering: which values make it true?
Use variables to represent numbers and write an expression when solving a real-world or mathematical problem
Solve real-world and mathematical problems by writing and solving equations of the form x + p = q and px = q
Write an inequality of the form x > c or x < c to represent a constraint or condition

clusters.description: Represent and analyze quantitative relationships between dependent and independent variables

standards.description: Use variables to represent two quantities in a real-world problem that change in relationship to one another

clusters.description: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving area, surface area, and volume

standards.description: Find the area of right triangles, other triangles, special quadrilaterals, and polygons by composing into rectangles or decomposing into triangles
Find the volume of a right rectangular prism with fractional edge lengths
Draw polygons in the coordinate plane given coordinates for the vertices; find perimeter and area
Represent three-dimensional figures using nets; use nets to find surface area
Recognize a statistical question as one that anticipates variability in the data
Understand that a set of data has a distribution described by its center, spread, and overall shape
Recognize that a measure of center summarizes data with a single number; a measure of variation describes how values vary
Display numerical data in plots on a number line, including dot plots, histograms, and box plots
Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context

sub.description: Describe nature of attribute under investigation
Give quantitative measures of center (median/mean) and variability (IQR/MAD)
Relate the choice of measures of center and variability to the shape of the data distribution
